title: When building images against x86_64-v2 by-default toolchain PPA, also enable the -v2 rebuild-test archive.
commit_message:
When building images against x86_64-v2 by-default toolchain PPA, also enable the -v2 rebuild-test archive.

Currently rebuild-test archive is unsigned, hence it is trusted=yes.
diff:
diff --git a/live-build/auto/config b/live-build/auto/config
index c02c47c..17ac1a8 100755
--- a/live-build/auto/config
+++ b/live-build/auto/config
@@ -983,6 +983,14 @@ case $PROJECT in
 		;;
 esac
 
+case ${EXTRA_PPAS:-} in
+	ubuntu-toolchain-r/x86-64-v2:*)
+		OPTS="${OPTS:+$OPTS }--apt-secure false --parent-mirror-chroot  http://ftpmaster.internal/ubuntu/ --parent-mirror-binary  http://ftpmaster.internal/ubuntu/"
+		MIRROR=http://rebuild-test.internal/ubuntu-test-rebuild-20210412-hirsute-v2/ubuntu
+                echo "LB_BOOTSTRAP_EXCLUDE=networkd-dispatcher" >> config/common
+		;;
+esac
+
 lb config noauto \
 	--mode ubuntu \
 	--distribution "$SUITE" \
@@ -1285,6 +1293,36 @@ EOF
 		fi
 		cat "$gpg_tmpdir/export.gpg" >> config/archives/extra-ppas.key.chroot
 		rm -f "$gpg_tmpdir/export.gpg"
+		if [ "$extra_ppa_origin" = "LP-PPA-ubuntu-toolchain-r-x86-64-v2" ]; then
+			cat <<EOF >> config/archives/extra-ppas.pref.chroot
+
+Package: *
+Pin: origin "rebuild-test.ubuntu.com"
+Pin-Priority: $extra_ppa_pin
+
+Package: src:*-signed src:linux* src:grub* src:fwupd* src:shim*
+Pin: origin "rebuild-test.ubuntu.com"
+Pin-Priority: -10
+
+Package: *
+Pin: origin "rebuild-test.internal"
+Pin-Priority: $extra_ppa_pin
+
+Package: src:*-signed src:linux* src:grub* src:fwupd* src:shim*
+Pin: origin "rebuild-test.internal"
+Pin-Priority: -10
+
+Package: src:*-signed src:linux* src:grub* src:fwupd* src:shim*
+Pin: release o=$extra_ppa_origin
+Pin-Priority: -10
+
+EOF
+			cat >> config/archives/extra-ppas.list.chroot <<EOF
+
+deb [trusted=yes] http://rebuild-test.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-test-rebuild-20210412-hirsute-v2/ubuntu @DISTRIBUTION@ main restricted universe multiverse
+#deb-src [trusted=yes] http://rebuild-test.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-test-rebuild-20210412-hirsute-v2/ubuntu @DISTRIBUTION@ main restricted universe multiverse
+EOF
+		fi
 	done
 	rm -rf "$gpg_tmpdir"
 	cp -a config/archives/extra-ppas.list.chroot \
